steps.title: Package and subsystem orientation
steps.description: Start with package entry points and README files to see how monitors, profiler, and matcher fit together as agent-facing subsystems.

steps.title: Monitors: collect opportunities
steps.description: Follow BaseMonitor through the Vinnova funding and Blue Science Park event monitors, including configuration and offline snapshots.

steps.title: Profiler: build company profiles
steps.description: Examine how ProfilerAgent retrieves sites, extracts evidence-backed claims, fills required fields, and caches validated CompanyProfile data.

steps.title: Matcher: score and explain recommendations
steps.description: Trace match from topic, timeline, and location scoring through thresholded ranking and deterministic or optional LLM explanations.

steps.title: Verification through tests
steps.description: Finish with subsystem tests and tested_by links covering monitor parsing and snapshots, profiler validation and fallbacks, and matcher scoring, ranking, and explanations.
